name: Inline
description: Horizontal flex layout with token-based gap. Children are laid out horizontally and wrap naturally.

gap.description: Spacing token name for gap between children

wrap.description: Whether children wrap to next line. Default: true.

do: Use Inline for horizontal layouts like button groups, tag lists, icon + text
Inline wraps by default — this is intentional for responsive layouts
doNot: Do not use Inline for vertical layouts — use Stack instead
Do not disable wrap unless you are certain the content will fit

accessibility.notes: Inline is a layout utility with no inherent semantics.
